import platform

def requires_pyvenv_patch(info):
    # Check if the operating system is macOS
    if platform.system() == 'Darwin':
        # Check if the version of macOS is less than 10.15 (Catalina)
        macos_version = platform.mac_ver()[0]
        major_version = int(macos_version.split('.')[0])
        minor_version = int(macos_version.split('.')[1])
        if major_version < 10 or (major_version == 10 and minor_version < 15):
            return True
    return False
